title: Noodle Crown — for June
dramaticTurn: A hurtful label is neither denied nor allowed to own the strands; inherited cold becomes self-chosen heat.

beats.job: name the wound without explaining June
break cold's claim to the whole story
let each filament choose and carry heat
give June the crown and release the image

accessibility.audioDescription: narration is written to carry the transformation; separate visual description transcript included
accessibility.lowVision: high-contrast symbolic silhouettes and large thematic title cards
